description: P0 parallelism feasibility ranking from actual code structure. No implementation in P0.

threading.assessment: NOT VIABLE as a speedup path: ~90% of profiled time is CPython bytecode (per-event calls, dict ops, dataclass churn) under the GIL. NumPy kernels that release the GIL (PCG64 bulk draw, interp core) are ~10% and already fast. Do not implement a thread pool.

vectorization.ar1_step: INHERENTLY_SEQUENTIAL within (sim, driver) across laps (eps_t depends on eps_{t-1}); vectorizable across sims/drivers only with exact op replication
vectorization.drift_arithmetic: SAFELY_VECTORIZABLE across sims (pure function of run-fixed slopes + laps_ahead)
vectorization.event_queue: SEMANTICALLY_RISKY to vectorize (data-dependent event order drives RNG cursor consumption; heap preserves order exactly instead)
vectorization.interp_sampler: SAFELY_VECTORIZABLE across the per-sim pool (same np.interp values; verify bit-identity)
vectorization.residual_recursion: POSSIBLY_VECTORIZABLE across sims with identical op order; requires parity proof
vectorization.rule: Do not vectorize if it changes update order, RNG consumption, retirement/order semantics, or scientifically meaningful floating behavior
